notes: NOT a conventional restaurant and there are NO per-dish prices anywhere - City Cruises San Diego is a harbour dining-cruise operator selling all-inclusive ticketed packages, so every dish here is recorded with a '-' the way other prix-fixe rooms in this corpus were handled. PACKAGE PRICING (from cityexperiences.com, captured Aug 2026, 'fees and taxes included in price'): San Diego Premier Dinner Cruise from $134 per person - 2.5 hours, three-course plated dinner (choice of one starter, one main, one dessert), live DJ, cocktail dress code, boarding 6:30pm / cruising 7:00-9:30pm Fri & Sat; San Diego Premier Bottomless Mimosa Brunch Cruise from $100 per person - buffet brunch, cruising 11:00am-1:00pm.
